# Health Psychology MSc/PG Dip/PG Cert

Our MSc in Health Psychology is designed to empower you with the skills and knowledge needed for a rewarding career in the health sector. With an accredited, cutting-edge curriculum, you'll gain expertise that opens doors to a wide range of career opportunities.

## Block teaching designed around you

You deserve a positive teaching and learning experience, where you feel part of a supportive community. That’s why most of our postgraduate taught students will enjoy an innovative approach to learning using block teaching, where you will study one module at a time. You will benefit from more regular assessments and feedback, a better study-life balance, and a simplified timetable that provides more time for work, professional development, caring responsibilities, and everything else that's important to you. Our block-taught courses are informed by industry practice, often accredited by professional bodies, and are delivered by passionate and talented academics, wh

r change, long-term conditions, digital health and emerging applications of AI in healthcare.
- **Focused learning:** Modules are delivered through DMU’s innovative block teaching approach, studying fewer modules concurrently and providing a more focused learning experience.
- **Applied and interprofessional learning:** Develop communication, reflective practice and professional skills through applied activities and interprofessional education.
- **State-of-the-art facilities:** Access dedicated psychology research facilities and technologies including EEG, eye-tracking and VR equipment, research spaces and a purpose-built food lab to support your learning and research.

**Teaching contact hours**

Contact hours may vary across the academic year, but typically on a full-time programme, you can expect around three full days of teaching per week, which may include small and medium group teaching and individual tutorials. Scheduled teaching should be supplemented by a significant amount of independent study each week, including reading, preparation for teaching sessions, assessment work and dissertation-related activity.

**Accreditation**

The programme is accredited by the British Psychological Society (BPS) and provides Stage 1 training in Health Psychology for suitably qualified appli

ebimages/course-page/accreditations/british-psychological-society.jpg)

**Academic expertise**

The course is taught by a team of research-active academics with expertise across Health Psychology and related areas. Staff work with external partners including the NHS, local authorities, charities and community organisations, helping to ensure that teaching is informed by contemporary research and real-world health challenges.

Staff publish their research in leading academic journals and present their work at national and international conferences, bringing current evidence and debates directly into your learning.
